title: Mummy Sorcerer in Neon City
description: A bandaged mummy-like figure with multiple glowing purple eyes stands in the foreground holding a glowing orb, with additional eyes and faces visible on its wrappings. In the background, a futuristic cyberpunk city floats on a rocky cliff surrounded by swirling purple mists and a dramatic red-purple sky with abstract shapes.
